# Florida-based logistics provider ShipMonk raises $290 million on the back of rising eCommerce demand

 Jonathan Shieber 

5:01 AM PST · December 2, 2020

Jan Bednar started ShipMonk with $70,000 in winnings from a string of student business plan competitions and launched the business that just closed on $290 million in new funding from a small warehouse with no air conditioning in the middle of Florida.

While Bednar’s new offices are still inside the warehouse his company operates, they now have air conditioning… and a $290 million financing round from Summit Partners to grow its business.

The Ft. Lauderdale, Fla.-based ShipMonk provides a slew of shipping and logistics services for small to medium-sized eCommerce businesses and right now — given the continuing COVID-19 pandemic — business is good.

“ We help SMBs and mid-market direct to consumer companies manage their supply chains. Help get their products from suppliers to facilities and connect with all of their sales channels including B2B … order management, transportation management, reverse logistics,” said Bednar. 

The company’s largest customers can book anywhere from $150 million to $250 million in revenue, but most of ShipMonk’s customers are actually small businesses pulling in between $1 million and $10 million on average.

# Your Fulfillment Data, On Demand: ShipMonk Insights

Data is the lifeblood of ecommerce, but for too long, it’s been trapped behind support tickets and CSV exports. Today, we’re changing that.

This approach may work for basic insights, but it doesn’t scale for mid‑market and enterprise brands managing hundreds of SKUs, multiple channels and constant cost pressure. Data requests can bottleneck in BI teams or CX queues, leaving merchants waiting days for insights that need to be acted on immediately.

At ShipMonk, we believe that timely, accurate information shouldn’t be a privilege, it should be table stakes. That’s why we’re launching ShipMonk Insights, an in‑platform analytics solution that gives merchants direct access to trustworthy fulfillment data. With Insights you can build your own reports and dashboards in minutes, right from within the ShipMonk platform.

### ShipMonk Insights: Your New Fulfillment Command Center

We are thrilled to launch ShipMonk Insights, an in-platform analytics solution that gives you direct, unfiltered access to trustworthy fulfillment data.

Insights is more than just a set of charts; it’s a single source of truth that aligns your team and the ShipMonk team on the exact same definitions for service levels, costs, and performance. You no longer have to wonder if your internal math matches ours—the data is unified.

# Beyond the Black Box: Why Your Returns Process Needs a Visual Audit Trail

In the high-stakes world of ecommerce, data is the engine behind everything from ad spend to inventory forecasting. Yet, for many brands, the ecommerce returns remain a frustrating black box. You know an item came back, and you know it wasn’t “new,” but the why is often lost in a sea of manual tickets and vague reports.

At ShipMonk, we believe the final step of the fulfillment journey shouldn’t be the most opaque. That’s why we’re introducing Photo-Proof Returns aka Quality Guard: a visual-first approach to reverse logistics that turns a cost center into a source of actionable intelligence.

### From Ambiguity to Actionable Intelligence

When an item arrives at our returns station in non-pristine condition, our associates don’t just flag it—they document it. By capturing overview shots and high-resolution detail close-ups, we surface the “ground truth” directly on your RMA page.

This shift from text-based reports to visual evidence provides three immediate competitive advantages:

- Definitive Dispute Resolution: Replace “he-said, she-said” with objective evidence. Your support team can resolve customer edge cases and claims in seconds, not days.
